Name: Gebal in Edom
ModernLocation: Between the Dead Sea and Petra, Jordan (region; exact site unidentified)
Description: A Gebal named among the neighbours conspiring against Israel in Psalm 83, listed with Edom, Moab, Ammon and others of the southern lands — a different Gebal from the Phoenician port of Byblos in the north.
BiblicalSignificance: Psalm 83 names this southern Gebal among the peoples whose counsel against Israel the psalmist asks God to defeat; it shows the name belonged to more than one place, and the southern one must not be confused with Byblos.
